__comment: SYNTHETIC, PARAMETERIZED TARGET board (issue #58). REQUIRES #86: queries the platform's INTENDED Log Analytics custom tables WpSpof_CL and WpFinding_CL, which NOTHING emits today (no telemetry-export path yet) — so this board does NOT render until #86 lands. Versioned here as the target schema. No real subscription/workspace/resource id, URL, or token — only Grafana template variables with synthetic defaults, bound at import time (see infra/grafana/README.md). Aggregate blast-radius/SPOF summary only, PII-free.
title: Aegis · Blast Radius & SPOF Summary
description: TARGET board — requires the #86 telemetry-export path. Reads the intended custom tables WpSpof_CL (Workload_s, NodeRef_s) and WpFinding_CL (Workload_s, BlastRadius_d, TimeGenerated), which are not emitted yet, so this board fails at query time until #86 lands. Versioned as the target schema.

list.name: subscription
list.label: Subscription
list.description: Deploy-time: set to the in-boundary subscription id (never committed).

list.name: workspace
list.label: Log Analytics workspace (resource id)
list.description: Deploy-time: set to the in-boundary Log Analytics workspace resource id (from deploy outputs).

list.name: workload
list.label: Workload
list.description: Synthetic workload scope — replace options at provision time with your in-boundary workloads.

panels.title: Active SPOFs (count)
panels.description: Number of single points of failure currently reported. Count only — no node identity shown.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
// Synthetic aggregate query — table name is a placeholder, rebind at provision time.
WpSpof_CL
| where Workload_s in (${workload:singlequote})
| summarize Spofs = dcount(NodeRef_s)

panels.title: Blast-radius distribution (bucketed)
panels.description: How many findings fall into each blast-radius bucket. Aggregate distribution only.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
WpFinding_CL
| where Workload_s in (${workload:singlequote})
| summarize Findings = count() by Bucket = case(BlastRadius_d <= 2, 'low', BlastRadius_d <= 6, 'medium', 'high')

panels.title: Max blast radius over time
panels.description: Peak blast radius across the selected workloads per interval. Aggregate maximum only.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
WpFinding_CL
| where Workload_s in (${workload:singlequote})
| summarize MaxBlastRadius = max(BlastRadius_d) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
